sections.title: About MyInvestor
texts: MyInvestor is the neobank specialised in investing: accounts, investments and mortgages, all digital. It operates as an agent of Andbank, the private banking group based in Andorra.
A bank needs flawless corporate governance: every board meeting, every general meeting and every change in the shareholder register, with legal certainty.

sections.title: Why they chose Sttok
texts: 1. The need to digitise its corporate governance processes securely and efficiently.
2. The legal certainty the platform provides in document management and the traceability of corporate resolutions.
3. Efficiency in holding digital board meetings and managing online voting.
4. Automated generation of corporate documents and minutes.
5. The ability to manage the shareholder register and corporate documents digitally.

uses.title: Shareholders' meetings
